title: BunshinRL: Whole-Workspace Forking for Agentic Reinforcement Learning Rollouts
abstract: arXiv:2611.10453v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) rollouts interleave model reasoning with tool calls in persistent workspaces. Scaling these rollouts incurs substantial memory costs for concurrent environments, while slow tool calls delay entire rollout batches. We present BunshinRL, an agentic RL rollout system that exploits shared environment state and recurring tool calls through three techniques: memory sharing across environments, tool-prefix caching, and speculative tool execution. These techniques build on BunshinFork, a novel live whole-workspace forking mechanism for containers. BunshinFork reconstructs process trees, shares memory copy-on-write, and preserves file, communication, and GUI state, enabling cached-state reuse and rollback after incorrect speculation. translated_title: BunshinRL：面向智能体强化学习推演的全工作区分叉技术
translated_abstract: 智能体强化学习（RL）推演在持久化工作区中将模型推理与工具调用交织进行。扩展这类推演会为并发环境带来巨大的内存开销，而缓慢的工具调用会拖延整批推演的进度。我们提出了BunshinRL，这是一个智能体RL推演系统，它通过三种技术来利用共享的环境状态和重复出现的工具调用：跨环境的内存共享、工具前缀缓存以及投机性工具执行。这些技术建立在BunshinFork之上——一种新颖的容器实时全工作区分叉机制。BunshinFork能够重建进程树、以写时复制方式共享内存，并保留文件、通信和GUI状态，从而支持缓存状态的复用以及错误投机后的回滚。我们通过修改Linux内核模块和CRIU实现了BunshinRL和BunshinFork。BunshinRL可将峰值内存降低多达43%，总内存消耗降低多达51%……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: BunshinRL基于新颖的容器全工作区实时分叉机制BunshinFork，通过跨环境内存共享、工具前缀缓存和投机性工具执行三项技术，显著降低智能体强化学习推演的内存开销并加速工具调用。
en_tdlr: BunshinRL leverages BunshinFork, a novel live whole-workspace forking mechanism for containers, to dramatically reduce memory overhead and accelerate tool calls in agentic RL rollouts via cross-environment memory sharing, tool-prefix caching, and speculative tool execution.
